Detailed Description

CMDU client factory interface.

Classes that need to dynamically create

See also
CmduClientFactory objects must use a factory to do so, instead of creating such objects directly (to avoid dependencies with real implementations). The factory will be provided as a dependency so it can be mocked while unit testing. A factory mock will return mock objects whenever an expectation of a call to create_instance() is satisfied.
